主要内容: On March 22, 2012, SAP AG, a German-based company, announced a dividend of €1.10 per share for the fiscal year 2011. The decision was made by the Supervisory Board following the recommendation of the Executive Board. This announcement was included in a press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 to the Form 6-K filing. The document also includes forward-looking statements, which are subject to risks and uncertainties. SAP AG is a stock corporation organized under the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany, with its principal executive offices located at Dietmar-Hopp-Allee 16, 69190 Walldorf. The filing was made under Form 20-F, which is used for annual reports by foreign private issuers. The document was signed by Dr. Werner Brandt, CFO, and Dr. Christoph Huetten, Chief Accounting Officer, on March 23, 2012.
